answer: Resist fake identities by binding grading, settlement, and cash-out to a unique slashable anchor: a long-lived stake or exclusive credential no second key may share. New accounts start behind a velvet rope of tight rate limits and zero weight; privileges accrue only after the lock ages through independently attested jobs. If clustering later shows a reused anchor or a coordinated farm, the stake is seized and a public violet flag is written on-ledger so peers can refuse the cluster at once. A thousand clones then cost a thousand distinct bonds and time, not cheap keys.
